title: Unidad Piquetera nationwide roadblock protest over social assistance and poverty
location: Roadblocks at Puente Pueyrredón and more than 120 points nationwide; exact sites not fully enumerated
scope: national, with multiple local gatherings; event grouping requires review
organizer: Unidad Piquetera; participating organizations named in reports include Coordinadora por el Cambio Social, MST Teresa Vive and Libres del Sur
threshold_50_evidence: No. TN reports more than 120 roadblock points but gives no simultaneous headcount at any one gathering; the number of sites cannot establish >=50 persons at one event.

start_date.summary: TN dates the completed national protest to 5 April 2023.

location.summary: TN names Puente Pueyrredón and over 120 national points; full location list unavailable.

scope.summary: TN calls it a national protest with actions at over 120 points.

organizer.summary: TN identifies Unidad Piquetera; associated organizations named in the article.

demands.summary: TN describes demands on social assistance, food, work tools, benefits and government engagement, in the setting of poverty and inflation.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No single-site participant estimate is reported; threshold remains unknown.

notes: A countrywide coordinated action may include distinct gatherings. Maintain as a national-action candidate pending event-level granularity and threshold evidence; do not sum locations.
open_questions: Which individual sites had at least 50 people at one time?
Were the 120+ sites one nationally organized action under original coding rules or separate local events?
What was the end date and state response at each relevant site?

title: ATE and CTA Autónoma wage protest and mobilization in Buenos Aires
location: Buenos Aires: gathering near Avenida de Mayo/9 de Julio, Ministry of Social Development, Ministry of Economy and Plaza de Mayo
scope: city-level mobilization; reports also describe a broader national labor action, which is not yet independently documented
organizer: Asociación de Trabajadores del Estado (ATE), CTA Autónoma and Movimiento Evita
threshold_50_evidence: No. TN confirms the mobilization and participating organizations but gives no attendance figure or qualitative crowd-size descriptor.

start_date.summary: TN reports the action began on 12 April 2023.

location.summary: TN identifies march route and government destinations in central Buenos Aires.

organizer.summary: TN names ATE, CTA Autónoma, Movimiento Evita and supporting social organizations.

demands.summary: TN reports demands for emergency pay, reopening wage negotiations and permanent status for contracted public workers.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance estimate or crowd-size description reported.

notes: The recorded candidate is the CABA march. The same-day strike and other local actions need separation based on evidence of each public gathering.
open_questions: Did the CABA gathering reach 50 participants simultaneously?
Which additional locations saw public gatherings, and what were their sizes?
What state response, if any, was reported?

title: Unidad Piquetera torch march and encampment at Plaza de Mayo
location: From Puente Pueyrredón in Avellaneda via central Buenos Aires to Plaza de Mayo; a next-day action at the Ministry of Social Development was announced
scope: regional/greater Buenos Aires, with a nationally organized coalition
organizer: Unidad Piquetera, including Polo Obrero and Libres del Sur among participants cited in reports
threshold_50_evidence: No. The body calls the procession an extensive column but provides no count; no participant number or simultaneous threshold is documented.

start_date.summary: Noticias Argentinas dates the torch march to Wednesday 19 April 2023.

location.summary: Article traces march from Puente Pueyrredón to Plaza de Mayo via 9 de Julio and Avenida de Mayo.

scope.summary: A coalition protest focused in Buenos Aires; reported as Unidad Piquetera action.

organizer.summary: Article identifies Unidad Piquetera and quotes Polo Obrero leader.

demands.summary: The article describes demands for increased social assistance, no cancellation of benefits, food for community kitchens and work materials.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: An extensive column is mentioned, without a number; threshold remains pending.

notes: The article states an overnight vigil and describes the next morning's 'empty pots' action prospectively. Do not code that action as completed until separately verified.
open_questions: Did the announced 20 April action occur and where?
Was the same encampment continuous through the next day?
Did a single gathering have at least 50 participants?

title: Teachers and students march for school security in Rosario
location: Rosario, Santa Fe; march to the provincial government building
organizer: Amsafé Rosario; teachers from Sadop and ATE also participated
threshold_50_evidence: The contemporaneous report describes a 'multitud' of teachers and students marching together. This is clear qualitative evidence of a large public gathering plausibly exceeding 50, although no exact count is reported.

start_date.summary: Article dates march to Tuesday 11 April 2023.

end_date.summary: The article says the act extended until midday; same-day end is supported.

location.summary: Article reports march in Rosario to the provincial government headquarters.

organizer.summary: Amsafé Rosario called march; Sadop and ATE employees participated.

demands.summary: Participants called for security and an end to attacks on schools, addressing provincial and national state responsibilities.

participants_original.summary: Article's qualitative descriptor: 'multitud de maestros y alumnos'; no count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: A contemporaneous report directly describes a multitude marching; use only as qualitative evidence and retain no numeric estimate.

notes: The attacks on schools discussed in the article were attributed to non-state actors and are not protester violence or state shootings. A minister's comments about security policy are not automatically coded as a response to the demonstration.
open_questions: Independent local source or attendance estimate to corroborate scale.
Whether any direct state response to the march was reported.
